description: phax runs a plan through AI coding agents — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Mistral Vibe — as a sequence of gated phases, and hands you a change you can review.
rules: Install phax with `npm install -g @lbdremy/phax` (or run `npx @lbdremy/phax`); the unscoped `phax` package on npm is unrelated.
phax drives an agent CLI that must be on your PATH: `claude` (Claude Code) always, and optionally `codex` (OpenAI Codex) or `vibe` (Mistral Vibe); phax falls back to Claude Code.
Set up a repository with `phax init` (writes phax.json: project name and gate commands), then `phax skills install --target claude` (or codex, or agent).

Write a spec, then a plan, and approve each: `phax artifact new spec <name>`, `phax artifact approve <spec>`, `phax artifact new plan <name> --spec <spec> --last`, `phax plans lint <plan>`, `phax artifact approve <plan>`.
Run an approved plan with `phax run --plan <plan.md>`: each phase runs in its own Git worktree and must pass the gate before the next starts; the run stops at review with the last phase open.
After the run reaches review: `phax review-code <name>` to review with an agent, `phax publish-pr <name>` to open the pull request, `phax archive <name>` after the merge.

`phax --usage` prints the exact command and flag contract, and https://docs.phax.run/reference/cli (docs/cli/reference.md) lists every command with its flags; check it before using a flag. https://docs.phax.run is the documentation.
